trainer.dialogueBefore: Galactic Grunt: Snow outside, a draught in here. A battle will warm me up!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Galactic Grunt: Now I'm cold and I've lost. Wonderful.

trainer.dialogueBefore: Galactic Grunt: A new world is nearly here, and you want to spoil it? Not on my watch!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Galactic Grunt: My watch is over, it seems.
